system_prompt_style.note: Instructions plus RepoContext-loaded files and Planning live reminder; no line numbers available in bundle.

env_context_strategy.note: Coder injects repo structure via RepoContext and exposes FileSystem read/search tools plus explorer sub-agent.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Model-agnostic strategies: tool-result clearing, sliding-window trimming, LLM summarization, tiered; all window-relative, with live usage reporting
context_compaction.note: Default Coder: ClearToolResults(max_fraction=0.7) and ToolOutputLimits (tool_output_pruning). Sliding window, summarizing, and core provider-native compaction are opt-in capabilities.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Read, write, edit, search files under a root; path-traversal and symlink safe, secrets read-only
observation_format.note: Observation conversion code not in bundle; Playwright browser capability may add other formats but not verifiable.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The model writes one Python script that calls many tools inside a [Monty](https://github.com/pydantic/monty) sandbox
tool_call_format.note: Default is Pydantic AI native tool calling (inferred, parser not in bundle); Code Mode opt-in gives code_as_action.

tool_count.note: Tool definition files (filesystem/_toolset.py etc.) listed but contents not in bundle; cannot count.

edit_primitive.note: README says 'read/write/edit/search' but edit tool arguments not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Connect any MCP server's tools; local by default, provider-native connectors opt-in
tool_schema_source.note: Pydantic AI derives schemas from function signatures (not shown in bundle); MCP via core capability.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: serves it to editors like Zed over the [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com)
protocol_standardization.note: MCP via core capability; ACP experimental in pydantic_ai_harness/experimental/acp/.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The model orchestrates sub-agents from one Python script: fan-out, chain, vote in a single tool call, with hard `max_agent_calls` budgets
loop_primitives.note: Default: typed agent loop (react). Dynamic Workflow opt-in enables voting.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Planning(), # structured task plans the model maintains

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: SubAgents(agents=[explorer], agent_folders=None), # delegate exploration off the main context
multi_agent_topology.note: Default Coder includes read-only explorer sub-agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Delegate self-contained tasks to named child agents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Flag tool calls that need human approval before they run
human_in_loop.note: Core opt-in capability; not in Coder default.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Model-owned task plans with a cache-safe live reminder

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A persistent, namespaced notebook: bounded prompt injection, on-demand search; in-memory/file/Postgres stores
long_term_memory.note: Opt-in Memory and Skills; not in Coder default. Conversation Search (BM25 over stored history) also opt-in.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Save, restore, resume (`continue_run`), and fork (`fork_run`) runs; file/SQLite/Mongo backends
state_persistence.note: Opt-in Step Persistence; durable execution via core.

self_verification.note: Macroscope review and Advisor exist but harness-enforced verification not evident in bundle.

retry_policy.note: Run loop code not in bundle.

rollback.note: Filesystem toolset source not in bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Cross-window USD/token budgets and per-response cost tracking, per model and per tenant
termination_condition.note: Final output ends run (inferred); Spend Limits opt-in.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Cross-window USD/token budgets and per-response cost tracking, per model and per tenant
cost_controls.note: Opt-in. Select Model and cache-bust warnings exist but not clearly routing/caching.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Command execution with allowlists, denylists, timeouts, and credential-stripping

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Shell( # allowlisted commands, LLM API keys stripped from their environment
execution_isolation.note: Local shell by default; Modal Sandbox (remote) opt-in.

tracing.evidence_quote: OpenTelemetry GenAI spans for every model and tool call

replayability.evidence_quote: Save, restore, resume (`continue_run`), and fork (`fork_run`) runs; file/SQLite/Mongo backends

eval_hooks.note: File tree truncated; Pydantic Evals is a sibling project.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Validate/block/redact user input, tool calls, tool results, and output, including secret masking and parallel async guards

target_domain.evidence_quote: A complete coding-agent stack: files, shell, repo context, planning, a read-only explorer sub-agent, and context controls

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Every model works: swap the string for [any provider's](https://ai.pydantic.dev/models/).

first_release_date.note: First tag date not in evidence.
